## `sum_ignore_NA`

*Available in [R](#sum_ignore_na-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Will sum values returning NA only if all values are NA, otherise will ignore

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    sum_ignore_NA(...)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `...` - numbers or vectors to be summed. Must be type logical or numeric.

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    a numeric vector of the same length as the arguments
